Home / Museum Ship Reports / Pacific Fleet Museum, Vladivostok

Location: Voyenno-Istoricheskiy Muzey Tikhookeanskogo Flota, Svetlanskaya St, 66, Vladivostok, Primorsky Krai, Russia, 690091

Visited: 19 September 2015

The Pacific Fleet Museum in Vladivostok is a typical naval museum - a converted pre-revolution merchants house filled with models, photographs and documents, manned by elderly veterans. Outside there were a collection of artifacts, including guns, mines, and two vessels - an MTB, and the mini-submarine Triton. Not easy to find, but worth a visit if you are in the area.
